futureTravellers.processing: Node @napi-rs/canvas performs crop, uniform resize, and transparent-canvas placement only. No procedural painting, no replacement alpha, no static base edits. Crop rectangles contain all pixels with alpha greater than 1 and padding; outlying alpha=1 generation haze is excluded by cropping.
